§6High-Performance Solvent§f

§aRadioactive, corrosive, and essential for bedrock ore processing and fullerene production!§f

High-Performance Solvent (HPS) is a corrosive, flammable, radioactive liquid made from §bReformate Gas§f and §bChlorine Gas§f in the §bIndustrial Mixer§f. It is required for full §bBedrock Ore§f processing and §bFullerene Solution§f production.

§6Production§f:
§b•§f §e750mB§f Reformate Gas + §e250mB§f Chlorine Gas → §e1,000mB§f HPS.
§b•§f RBMK Irradiation Channel: Chlorinated Petroleum Wax → §e100mB§f HPS.

§6Uses§f:
§b•§f Ore Acidizer: §e250mB§f HPS for cleaning bedrock ore primary fractions.
§b•§f Fullerene Solution: §e500mB§f HPS + Fine Soot → §e250mB§f.
§b•§f Cadmium and Arsenic extraction from plants and scraps.

§cWARNING:§f HPS is radioactive, corrosive, AND flammable. Store it only in §bHazardous Material Tanks§f - never standard fluid tanks!

§ePS:§f HPS enables access to §bfullerene§f and §bcrystalline fullerite§f, critical for late-game machines. The Chlorine Gas + Reformate Gas recipe is the most practical route.
